profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Dynamic Imaging, 3D Visualization & Product Experiences | Full-Stack and Native Apple Development | Creator of GIFBarn
profile.summary:
A senior engineer who builds visual, interactive products across enterprise web systems, dynamic imaging, 3D visualization, developer infrastructure, and native Apple platforms.

I build software that turns complex imaging, visualization, and product-experience problems into tools people can actually use.
 
For more than 20 years, I’ve worked across front-end architecture, full-stack web development, dynamic imaging, 3D visualization, developer tooling, CI/CD, and production reliability. At LiquidPixels, I help build and evolve enterprise visualization systems that power dynamic product experiences. My work ranges from user-facing applications and internal tools to build systems, infrastructure, and long-term platform modernization.
 
I’m also the creator of GIFBarn, a native app for macOS, iPhone, and iPad that makes finding and sharing reaction GIFs fast. Building and shipping it has given me the opportunity to work deeply with SwiftUI, StoreKit, cross-platform Apple development, accessibility, product design, and App Store distribution.
 
I’m at my best at the intersection of engineering, product thinking, and visual experiences, especially when I can make a complicated workflow faster, clearer, and more reliable.
 
Core areas: Software architecture · Front-end engineering · Full-stack development · Dynamic imaging · 3D visualization · SwiftUI · Vue · Nuxt · JavaScript · Perl · MySQL · Docker · CI/CD · Developer tooling

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Build and evolve enterprise dynamic-imaging, product-visualization, digital asset management, and web-platform software across front-end applications, back-end services, developer tooling, deployment systems, and production infrastructure.
• Co-invented a patented on-demand 3D image-viewer architecture that combines interactive 3D models with dynamically generated product imagery.
• Lead front-end architecture and implementation for customer-facing visualization experiences, company websites, internal applications, and engineering tools.
• Architected and developed a modular web framework and design system used across the company’s websites and web applications. Built with Vue and Node.js, it includes more than 50 reusable components and shared foundations for layout, navigation, forms, content, responsive behavior, and application functionality.
• Established reusable development patterns that improve consistency, reduce duplicated work, simplify maintenance, and accelerate delivery across multiple web properties.
• Design and develop full-stack systems using Vue, Nuxt, Node.js, JavaScript, Perl/Mojolicious, MySQL, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines.
• Modernize long-lived applications, frameworks, and build systems while preserving compatibility with established customer integrations and production environments.
• Collaborate across engineering, product, QA, integration, support, and customer-facing teams to take features from requirements and design through implementation, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.
• Provide advanced technical support for complex application, integration, imaging, and production issues.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed customer-facing and internal web applications for LiquidPixels’ LiquiFire dynamic-imaging platform and digital asset management products.
• Built standards-based HTML image viewers that replaced legacy Flash implementations, delivering interactive, dynamically generated product imagery through LiquiFire.
• Maintained compatibility with Internet Explorer 7 and newer browsers while supporting modern desktop and touch-based experiences.
• Designed and developed a multi-file drag-and-drop asset uploader with real-time progress reporting using HTML5, AJAX, CSS, and Perl back-end integration.
• Completely redesigned and rebuilt the primary web application used to configure, maintain, and manage the LiquiFire product platform. Created a responsive interface for modern desktop and touch browsers.
• Integrated front-end functionality with Perl-based back-end services and third-party frameworks.
• Served as the primary engineering contact for a third-party licensed application distributed to customers, including redesigning the tool and packaging it as a macOS installer.
• Provided Level 3 customer support, diagnosing and resolving complex application, integration, and imaging issues.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Developed and maintained mission-critical C++ software for the Patriot Missile System, working within a large, complex codebase of more than 500,000 lines.
• Designed, implemented, tested, and integrated new functionality from initial requirements and concept development through software design, coding, validation, and long-term maintenance.
• Led requirements analysis for the Trainers team, reviewing Software Investigation Requests against the existing codebase to identify conflicts, gaps, technical risks, and implementation impacts.
• Contributed to a major software re-hosting initiative that modernized the Patriot platform and reduced its reliance on aging hardware. Converted legacy JOVIAL code to C++ using internal conversion tools, then manually reviewed, corrected, and optimized the resulting code.
• Performed integration and regression testing across proprietary and commercial hardware for each software build.
• Investigated and resolved complex defects using GDB, Workbench Debugger, and Patriot-specific diagnostic and data-collection tools.
• Applied object-oriented design principles to deliver reliable software corrections and new capabilities while meeting demanding government contract schedules.
• Authored software designs and Software Trouble Reports, supported system validation efforts, and collaborated with multidisciplinary engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle.

patents.title: On-Demand 3D Image Viewer
patents.description: An example embodiment may involve obtaining, by a graphical viewer, a 3D model of an object; requesting, by the graphical viewer, one or more 2D textures for the object from an image server application; receiving, by the graphical viewer, the one or more 2D textures from the image server application; possibly based on the 3D model of the object and the one or more 2D textures, generating, by the graphical viewer, a texturized image representation of the object; and displaying, by the graphical viewer, the texturized image representation of the object.
